description: The Aviation Weather Center's combined SIGMET cache file (sigmets.cache.xml, XML: the US convective and non-convective SIGMETs and the international ones, data API v4.34) read into the shape the weather store keeps, one advisory an area, a convective SIGMET's CONV hazard as CONVECTIVE: [{hazard, type, altitude_low_ft, altitude_high_ft, raw, valid_from, valid_to, issued, coords}].
